name: app-lavender-key-takeaways-italic-serif-paragraph-with-highlighted-words
title: Key Takeaways in Italic Serif
whatItIs: A pale lavender gradient slide with a tiny Key Takeaways label, a centred italic serif paragraph in pale grey-lilac where key words (accessibility, clean modern UI, scaled typography) are dark navy, and a faint dashed arc at left.
whatItMeans: Only the important words are dark, so the paragraph can be skimmed, and the italic serif feels reflective.
techniques: Pale text with dark highlighted key words

vocabulary.definition: Setting only selected words in a darker tone.
A slanted serif typeface giving an editorial voice.
A slide summarising what was learned.
